name: @silfable/desktop
description: Local-first AI trading runtime with enforceable limits

scripts.dist:win: node ../../scripts/assert-windows-signing-env.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 -c.forceCodeSigning=true && node ../../scripts/audit-windows-artifacts.mjs release && node ../../scripts/generate-release-checksums.mjs release

scripts.dist:linux:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64
